ITEM 1 | Orange-colored pieces, cut into rounded slices and chunks with smooth, slightly glossy skin and a faint sheen, some with a visible pale-orange core ring; soft-cooked, holding shape, moderately moist, piece sizes about 2 to 5 cm long and 1 to 2 cm thick, clustered in the center-left of the plate covering roughly one-third of the plate surface | 150
ITEM 2 | Small single orange-yellow chunk with a slightly rough, matte surface and a darker yellow-orange interior, about 1.5 cm across, sitting alone at the top-left edge of the cluster on the plate | 5
ITEM 3 | Small orange piece with a rounded cut face showing a lighter center ring, about 2 cm across, sitting separately at the lower-left edge of the cluster, smooth and slightly moist | 6
